data.comment:
# Comfy Video Extend- Grok

Upload a short video and a text prompt describing the next scene. Generate a seamless video extension using Grok extend. Runs on Comfy Cloud and needs Comfy Cloud partner credits.

**How it works:** The Comfy nodes form the complete template graph. Run submits the graph to Comfy Cloud and saves its outputs.

**Try this:** Change the prompt or the Load node inputs and run again to compare results.

Source: https://github.com/Comfy-Org/workflow_templates/blob/1ae390968e323dba24a6991d1860ded051f5a79b/templates/api_grok_video_extend.json (MIT). Model licenses apply separately.

data.prompt: Begin in deep space, camera slowly ascends, pulls back and orbits forward from a ring space station, revealing a vast futuristic space city with brilliant nebulae and flying starships, epic sci-fi style; background music is grand orchestral score, quiet and low at first, strings and vocals rise with the camera, drums and brass erupt at climax, magnificent and awe-inspiring.
